show: Bend the Knee: A Song of Ice and Fire Podcast
titel: Ep. 227: - Boiled Leather Part 1 | AFFC & ADWD Prologues

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Analyzing the prologues of A Feast for Crows and A Dance with Dragons using Boiled…
kurzfassung: The hosts begin their Boiled Leather reread by comparing the prologues of A Feast for Crows and A Dance with Dragons. They examine how both chapters immediately thrust the reader into heavy magical elements, ancient lore, and deep mysteries involving the Citadel and skinchanging. The conversation also explores writing structures, George R. R. Martin's struggles with book splitting, and how these opening segments set up future events in the series.
stichpunkte: Comparison of the prologues for A Feast for Crows and A Dance with Dragons
The heavy shift toward magical elements immediately following A Storm of Swords
Pate stealing the master key in Oldtown and encountering a mysterious alchemist
Varamyr Sixskins establishing the rules and taboos of warging and skinchanging
Discussion on George R. R. Martin's decision to split the massive manuscript into two books
Parallels between northern skinchangers and southern face-changing abilities
Speculation on archmaester Walgrave, dragon eggs, and Citadel conspiracy theories
Audiobook narration differences between Roy Dotrice and other readers across the series

clips.hook: A huge magical shift in the series
clips.text: Following the resurrection of Catelyn Stark at the end of the previous book, both prologues immediately plunge the reader back into heavy magic and ancient lore.

clips.hook: Taboos of warging and breaking the rules
clips.text: The discussion turns to the strict rules associated with skinchanging and how Bran is expected to violate those boundaries later in the narrative.

clips.hook: News travel times and missing the Battle of the Blackwater
clips.text: The hosts note how slowly information moves across the world, mentioning that characters in these chapters are unaware of key events because Renly had already died before a certain battle.

clips.hook: Fascinated by Oldtown and the Citadel
clips.text: The speaker expresses a strong personal preference for the southern storylines, praising the deep world-building and future setups centered around the Citadel.

clips.hook: Ranking the prologue chapters out of hundreds
clips.text: The hosts estimate the total chapter count across the series and debate whether the Oldtown prologue deserves a spot among the top twenty-five chapters.

beschreibung:
AFFC Prologue — Pate
In Oldtown, struggling Citadel novice Pate steals a master key in exchange for a gold dragon from a mysterious alchemist, hoping to use the money to win Rosey. After completing the exchange, Pate suddenly collapses and dies, while the chapter also introduces rumors of Daenerys's dragons, Marwyn the Mage, and a burning glass candle.
ADWD Prologue — Varamyr Sixskins
A dying Varamyr Sixskins reflects on his life as a powerful skinchanger and the forbidden acts his mentor Haggon taught him never to commit. After unsuccessfully attempting to take over Thistle's body, Varamyr dies and enters his wolf for his "second life," later encountering Thistle resurrected as a blue-eyed wight.
